# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** eight-year-old  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P4](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0004), [v3 ch.Change P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v3 ch.Again P22](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0022), [v3 ch.Again P24](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0024)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Dora](../character/dora.md) (sibling), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) (cousin)

## Appearance

Davy Keith is a handsome child with a snub nose and a single dimple in one of his cheeks. His round head is covered in a crop of fuzzy, curly yellow ringlets.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## Personality

Davy Keith possesses an inherent knack for winning love, though he is full of mischief and often makes faces at others. Described as a reformed character, he can be heedless, forgetful, and finds it hard to sit still. He exhibits a practical nature devoid of imagination, paired with an energetic, inquisitive, and curious mindset that drives him to ask questions and observe everything around him. He aspires to work as a storekeeper who keeps abundance of candy and bananas, and he aims to live to be a hundred years old.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 IX A Question of Color P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P14](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0014), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), +6 more_

## History

Davy Keith and his twin sister, [Dora](../character/dora.md), were brought to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). He quickly proved to be a handful, causing trouble by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church, coaxing [Dora](../character/dora.md) into a pigpen before pumping water over her, and hiding a toad in Marilla's bed. Soon after, he trapped [Dora](../character/dora.md) in a toolhouse and lied about it, but broke down in remorse when he realized lying was wrong, prompting [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to educate and discipline him. After being caught stealing plum jam and skipping his prayers to test [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), he received reassurance of Anne's affection, though he grew jealous when she paid attention to other children. He also frequently ruined household meals and received scoldings from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) over his poor table manners.

Following the death of their uncle, [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), money was left for the twins' care, securing their permanent future at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Davy eventually developed a pattern of confiding his moral dilemmas and misdeeds to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), seeking her guidance when tormented by guilt, such as after coercing [Dora](../character/dora.md) into skipping [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing and lying to cover it up. As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) grew older and left for college, Davy frequently comforted her before her departures, eagerly greeted her during her visits home, and sought her advice on his weekend schoolwork.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P9](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0009), +42 more_

## Quotes

> "You don’t look like a lady who’d whip a little boy just ’cause he couldn’t keep still. Didn’t you find it awful hard to keep still when you was only ‘s old as me?"
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003)

> "You was a girl once, I s’pose, though it’s awful funny to think of it. Dora can sit still . . . but there ain’t much fun in it I don’t think. Seems to me it must be slow to be a girl. Here, Dora, let me liven you up a bit."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)

> "Marilla washed it yesterday . . . and Mrs. Wiggins scoured me with hard soap the day of the funeral. That’s enough for one week. I don’t see the good of being so awful clean. It’s lots more comfable being dirty."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P31](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0031)

> "But it was such a jolly big caterpillar . . . I picked him up on the church steps just as we went in. It seemed a pity to waste him. And say, wasn’t it fun to hear that girl yell?"
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P43](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0043)

> “I . . . did something else today,” went on Davy in a muffled voice. “I’m sorry now but I’m awful scared to tell you. You won’t be very cross, will you? And you won’t tell Marilla, will you?”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--davy-keith.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) serves as an affectionate friend and guardian to Davy, possessing the authority to discipline and guide him when he gets into trouble. After Davy comes to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gently helps manage his frequent misbehavior, such as discreetly disposing of a toad he hid in Marilla's bed. Though she confronts him over his dishonesty and mischief, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) harbors a special affection for him and takes time to reassure him when he feels jealous.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), +17 more_

### [Dora](../character/dora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Dora](../character/dora.md) is Davy's twin sister, brought alongside him to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Davy frequently targets her with pranks, such as coaxing her into a pigpen, pumping water over her, or locking her inside a toolhouse and lying about her whereabouts. Despite his complaining and misbehavior toward her, Davy also gets jealous of others when seeking attention at home.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), +27 more_

- Sibling of — twin brother and sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +12 more</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is Davy's third cousin who brings him to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and holds authority over him. She helps discipline and educate Davy for his various misdeeds, such as hiding a toad in her bed, trapping [Dora](../character/dora.md) in a toolhouse, and testing her warnings by skipping his prayers. Despite comparing his frequent mischief to Dora's good behavior, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a special affection for Davy despite his faults.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), +15 more_

- Relative of — third cousin  <sub>[v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032)</sub>

### [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--milty-boulter.md)

Milty is a friend and playmate of Davy, with the two often going fishing together. Their relationship also has a rivalrous edge, as they compete with each other over physical height and bragging rights.
